newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Taiwan Lite-On unit closes US$45 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Lite-On unit closes US$45 mln FRN.

text.p: Taiwan Lite-On Technology Corp unit LTC (HK) Ltd's US$45 million floating rate notes issue has closed, arranger HSBC Markets said on Tuesday.
The five-year notes were issued at par to float at 70 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. There is a put option in year three and call options in years three and four.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 76.6 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$5 million each, are Citicorp International and HSBC Markets.
Co-arranger BNP committed to US$6 million.
Lead managers, with US$4 million each, are Banque Indosuez and WestLB.
Managers, with US$4 million each, are The Chinese Bank, Yasuda Trust and Tokai Asia.
Co-managers are Bank Paribas, with US$3 million, and Bank Hapoalim, Development Bank of Singapore and Rabobank, with US$2 million each.
Signing is set for December 6. The payment date is December 16.
